name: Churn Water (Recharge 4–6)
description: The creature thrashes violently. Each creature within 20 feet of the creature must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The water within 60 feet of the creature becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. Each creature that starts its turn on the deck of a ship in this area must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or fall overboard.
